name: POST /api/leadflow/sequences/enrollments/:id/stop - a reactive signal stops, replaces or pauses
description:
Automation never argues with a human. Nine reactive signals, each mapped to stop, replace or pause (bd2225bb-bb62-41d8-8bc4-3774ed4e3a6b#AC1).

REPLACE IS DISTINCT FROM STOP (bd2225bb-bb62-41d8-8bc4-3774ed4e3a6b#AC2), and collapsing them breaks one case or the other. A booked meeting does not end the relationship, it makes the booking CTA wrong - so logistics reminders for that accepted meeting SHOULD continue. Treating it as a full stop goes silent on somebody expecting a reminder; treating it as no-op spams somebody who has already booked. Verified live: booking_made and callback_requested map to replace, rep_activity to pause, and the rest to stop.

A VERIFIED PAYMENT STOPS EVERYTHING (bd2225bb-bb62-41d8-8bc4-3774ed4e3a6b#AC3). Presale messaging to a customer who has just paid is the single most visible failure this list prevents. MEASURED LIVE: payment_verified returned action stop, cancelled 12 queued steps and created the owner task.

QUEUED STEPS ARE CANCELLED BY CLAIMING THEM. Each remaining step is INSERTed as executed-and-skipped, so a tick ALREADY IN FLIGHT cannot send one - the claim is taken and the executor sees it as owned. Simply setting a status would leave a race in which an in-flight tick sends the very step the stop was meant to prevent.

EVERY STOP RECORDS ITS REASON AND CREATES AN URGENT OWNER TASK (bd2225bb-bb62-41d8-8bc4-3774ed4e3a6b#AC4). The reason lives on the enrolment rather than only in a log, because the first question about a stopped sequence is why and a join to find out is a join somebody will forget. The task exists because a stop means a human now owns what the automation was doing, and a stop with nobody told is a silent handoff. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: Stopping an unknown enrolment is refused
NEGATIVE: an unknown signal is refused rather than treated as a stop
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: signal must be one of inbound_reply, booking_made, callback_requested, opt_out, hard_bounce, payment_verified, status_change, rep_activity, service_issue
errorCases.when: an unrecognised signal is supplied. Defaulting to stop would be the safe direction for the prospect but would hide a miswired subscriber that meant to send something else.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
